description: The template's OWN dependency automation — distinct from template/renovate.json, which is what gets STAMPED into every consumer app. This repo had none until 23/09/2026: with `requireConfig: required` on the estate runner, an unconfigured repo is skipped on every run, so the two design-system floors below sat unwatched (found in a stamped app running @poodle64/ui 2026.9.9 against a published 2026.9.17).

customManagers.description: template/frontend/package.json.jinja is real JSON wearing a .jinja extension for its scaffold interpolations elsewhere in the file; Renovate's built-in npm manager only recognises a literal package.json and never opens here. This regex manager reads the two shared design-system floors directly, so a new @poodle64/ui or @poodle64/design-tokens publish reaches this repo exactly as it reaches any consumer app — the shared packageRule below (matchPackageNames, automerge:false) already governs both by name.

packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 (the native compiler) is held below 7. Upstream is not ready: typescript-eslint's peer is <6.1, svelte-check's is ^5 || ^6, @sveltejs/kit 3 and @sveltejs/package 3 peer ^6, and `svelte-kit sync`, dev and build crash on 7.0.2 (sveltejs/kit#17537; svelte2tsx and svelte-check crash, sveltejs/language-tools#3063; typescript-eslint tracks it in typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940). Retires when those three land TS 7 support.

SvelteKit 3, adapter-static 4 and @sveltejs/package 3 move together and are held. Upstream blocker: bits-ui (every app's and @poodle64/ui's component base) pulls runed 0.35, whose peer is @sveltejs/kit ^2 (huntabyte/bits-ui#2243, 'SvelteKit 3 support'). Also measured 02/11/2026: @sveltejs/package 3 no longer rewrites `$lib` in dist, so a built @poodle64/ui ships unresolvable `$lib/…` imports (a consumer's build fails 'Could not load src/lib/utils.js'), and kit 3 drops `$lib`, svelte.config.js and `$app/stores` for `#lib`, the Vite plugin options and `$app/state` — a fleet-wide source rewrite (`npx sv migrate sveltekit-3`) to run as one factory change after bits-ui lands. Tracked in radar-hooves/app-factory#60.
adapter-static 4 peers @sveltejs/kit ^3, so it is held with SvelteKit 3 (see the rule above; radar-hooves/app-factory#60).

@tanstack/table-core 9 is a rewrite, not an upgrade: table features are declared up front (`_features`), `getCoreRowModel`/`getSortedRowModel`/`getFilteredRowModel` become `createCoreRowModel`/`createSortedRowModel`/`createFilteredRowModel`, and `ColumnDef` takes extra type arguments. @poodle64/ui re-exports `ColumnDef` and wraps `createTable` in `createSvelteTable`, so the bump breaks the table API every app calls (svelte-check: 27 errors in ui alone, measured 02/11/2026). Not an upstream fault: a deliberate @poodle64/ui major, with the apps' tables migrated beside it, tracked in radar-hooves/app-factory#61.

Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 breaks the kit's own variant tests: `dark:hidden` and every `data-*` shorthand variant compile to no rule at all under it (packages/ui `dark-variant.test.ts` and `data-state-variants.test.ts`, 6 failures; green on 4.3.2 with everything else equal, measured 02/11/2026 on an otherwise-clean main). Retires when a release compiles them again.

bits-ui 2.20 leaves a closed dialog's title in the document, so @poodle64/ui's `AppDialog` fails `reports its own dismissal through onOpenChange` (composed-chrome.test.ts; 2.19.5 passes, 2.20.2 fails, nothing else changed, measured 02/11/2026). Retires when ui's dialog or bits-ui is reconciled.

sysinfo 0.40 changes `System::new` to return a `Result`, so the telemetry kit stops compiling (`expected &mut System, found &mut Result<System, Error>`, measured 02/11/2026; 0.39.6 compiles). A code change to the kit, not a routine bump: it ships as its own telemetry release. Renovate also reported an artifact error on it, since cargo resolved 0.40.1 inside the three-day wait.

The uv pin is the household's, not this repo's: master-project's setup-uv action and its renovate preset (`constraints.uv`) hold it at 0.9.30, because a newer uv rewrites every marker of uv.lock. A bump to 0.13 left the kits job without its dev tools (`Failed to spawn: ruff`). The estate moves it in one change, from master-project, not here.

Node moves with the estate baseline (24, the LTS every app and the template run), not ahead of it: Node 26 and @types/node 26 are held until master-project moves the baseline, and the factory then moves first.

pnpm-workspace.yaml `overrides` are security floors for transitive packages, pinned to the major their dependents import; a major bump breaks them (cookie 2.0.1 removed `parse` and `serialize`, so SvelteKit 2's cookie.js fails to build, measured 02/11/2026 in the scratch render; devalue 6, fast-uri 4 and nanoid 6 are the same shape). The preset disables this for `overrides` dep types; a workspace file's are not read as those, so it is disabled by file.

astral-sh/setup-uv above 8.2 breaks the scratch render on the self-hosted NixOS runner: it cannot find `ldd` to tell glibc from musl (`Failed to determine glibc or musl`), and the same job then builds `pyyaml==6.0.3` from source and fails (v8.3.2 and v10.3.3 measured 02/11/2026; 8.2.0 passes). The household wrapper in master-project owns the real setup-uv; this repo only copies it, because it is public and cannot reach a private action. Retires when the runner or the action resolves it.

Python 3.15 is held: the estate runs 3.14 (every app, the template's `.python-version` and its base image), and on 3.15 the scratch render builds `pyyaml==6.0.3` from source and fails (`failed to import Cython … undefined symbol: PyFrozenDict_Type`, measured 02/11/2026), since the wheels the stack needs do not exist for it yet. The estate moves its Python in one change, the factory first, once they do.
